displacements._about: Typical starting displacement (Phase 4). Shaft-type values describe the DISTAL part relative to the proximal part: shortening_mm, lateral_mm, posterior_mm, varus_deg (negative = valgus), apex_anterior_deg (negative = apex posterior), external_rotation_deg. Fragment-type values: away_mm (straight away from the fracture site), proximal_mm, use_impaction (use the impaction stored with a depressed fragment). Shortening is reduced automatically until the bone ends no longer overlap.

fractures.line_basis: Compendium drawing (S93-S94), the Sanders lines (Sanders 1993, Fig 1) measured on this posterior facet (27.4 mm wide: A and B divide it into thirds, C is its medial edge), and the heat maps of Shi 2023 (Figs 7 and 8, provided by the owner): the main axial band runs along the facet about 15 degrees to the long axis, front end lateral; on the medial wall a band runs from top to sole just behind the sustentaculum; the line leaves the sole lengthwise, medial of centre; the sustentaculum itself is not broken (also Ni 2021; Shi 2022). On the lateral wall the line is vertical at the angle of Gissane (S94). Sanders 1993 counts the pieces of the posterior facet on the coronal CT: type II two pieces, III three, IV four or more; the letter says which line (A lateral, B central, C medial).
fractures.note: Built as Sanders IIA, the commonest Sanders 2 subtype in Guo 2021 (109 of 197): one line (A) through the posterior facet; the lateral column is pushed down into the body (joint depression); the medial two thirds stay with the sustentaculum.
